seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: MIS (LOBs CFG, SFG, FIG, PPIF, MIS Other) and MA (LOBs RD&A, ERS, PS). Revenue by LOB = external revenue (release Table 2); MIS intersegment = royalty charged to MA; MA intersegment = fees charged to MIS; elim = Eliminations column of the release segment table (revenue row). Segment Adjusted Operating Income, adjusted margins, D&A, restructuring, other items and segment operating income from the release "Financial Information by Segment" table (segment revenue there includes intersegment). mis_recurring / ma_recurring = "Relationship" revenue and *_transaction = "Transaction" revenue from release "Transaction and Relationship Revenue" table. mis_ratings_total not shown (null). 2019 LOB realignments (Q1-19): REIT revenue moved from SFG to CFG; Bureau van Dijk FACT product moved from RD&A to ERS (prior-year LOB revenue reclassified in 2019 releases). ASC 842 adopted 1-Jan-2019 (operating lease ROU assets and lease liabilities on BS). From 2019 overhead allocation uses a fixed "Baseline Pool" (10-K). MAKS classified held for sale (assets/liabilities held for sale on BS).

Table 12 - 2019 Outlook
Moody's outlook for 2019 is based on assumptions about many geopolitical conditions and macroeconomic and capital market factors, including interest rates, foreign currency exchange rates, corporate profitability and business investment
spending, mergers and acquisitions, consumer borrowing and securitization, and the level of debt capital markets activity. These assumptions are subject to uncertainty, and results for the year could differ materially from our current
outlook. Our guidance assumes foreign currency translation at end-of-quarter exchange rates. Specifically, our forecast for the remainder of 2019 reflects exchange rates for the British pound (£) of $1.23 to £1 and for the euro (€) of $1.09
to €1.

ngaap.notes: Adjusted Operating Income excludes the impact of: i) amortization of acquired intangible assets; ii) Acquisition-Related Expenses; iii) restructuring charges; iv) an impairment and tax charge pursuant to the planned divestiture of MAKS; and v) a captive insurance company settlement. Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS exclude the impact of: i) amortization of acquired intangible assets; ii) Acquisition-Related Expenses; iii) restructuring charges; iv) an impairment and tax charge pursuant to the planned divestiture of MAKS; and v) a captive insurance company settlement. The Company defines free cash flow as net cash provided by operating activities minus payments for capital additions. Organic (non-constant-currency) measures published: Organic MA revenue 481.3 vs 436.0 prior year, growth 10.0%; Organic RD&A revenue 308.5 vs 280.3, growth 10.0%; Organic ERS revenue 130.8 vs 115.3, growth 13.0%; Organic PS revenue 42.0 vs 40.4, growth 4.0%. Note: the Q3-19 release Table 8 wording says Adjusted Operating Income excludes "amortization of acquired intangible assets", but its reconciliation (and Table 6) adds back total depreciation and amortization (48.6), consistent with other quarters. Captive insurance company settlement (15.5 pre-tax; MIS 9.4, MA 6.1; within operating/SG&A expense, not a separate IS line) added to exclusions. Restructuring is a 1.0 reversal in Q3-19 (negative cost).
